title: Paediatric Protocol
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Use a smaller field of view and a coil matched to the limb, which maintains resolution in a smaller joint.
Expect red marrow and know its normal distribution for the age.
Avoid contrast unless the question requires it, which it usually does not.
Automated reading is trained predominantly on adult knees, so a paediatric study is the setting where it should be trusted least and where normal variation is greatest.
